ruleEvidence.meaning: Tooltip gates LC gains by named Ascendant Gleam; the same named character condition for the N4 additional hit is implemented as tally.moonsign >= 2. The sheet does not implement a resource callback.

ruleEvidence.origin: application ledger convention supplied for this protocol; not an upstream timing or first-tick assertion

description.0: After using the Elemental Skill Heaven and Earth Made Manifest, Zibai will change to this mode. This mode lasts at most 15s and has the following properties:
1: Normal and Charged Attacks are converted into <geo>Geo DMG</geo> that cannot be overridden by other infusions.

The Elemental Skill Heaven and Earth Made Manifest will also be converted to the Elemental Skill Spirit Steed's Stride: When Zibai has at least 70 Phase Shift Radiance, she can consume 70 Phase Shift Radiance to unleash Spirit Steed's Stride and cause two instances of Geo DMG. The second instance will be considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.
description.3: A maximum of 100 Phase Shift Radiance points can be accrued, and Zibai can accumulate them in the following ways:
4: She gains 10 points every second she is in the Lunar Phase Shift mode.
She gains 5 points when hitting an opponent with her Normal Attacks. She can gain Phase Shift Radiance points in this way once every 0.5s.
description.7: When nearby party members trigger Lunar-Crystallize, they will also accrue 35 Phase Shift Radiance points for Zibai. Points can be gained this way once every 4s. Unleashing the special elemental skill Spirit Steed's Stride will reset the CD for Phase Shift Radiance gained this way.
description.9: Zibai will leave this mode after unleashing Spirit Steed's Stride 4 times, or when the skill's duration ends.

preservedRuleText.originalBurstExtensionText: When cast, if Zibai is in the Lunar Phase Shift, the duration of the current Lunar Phase Shift will extend by an additional 1.7s.

crossReference.identity: dynamic webpage; no fixed repository revision, raw-byte hash or archived snapshot is claimed
crossReference.observation: The page repeats the same talent rules, states that character findings have not yet been added, and provides no frame findings; the linked Evidence Vault has empty mechanics sections.
crossReference.scope: semantic corroboration and a documented evidence gap; not authority for first-tick phase, callback order or exact boundary frames

observationContract.scope: C0; real observed Phase Shift Radiance ledger for one Lunar Phase Shift lifecycle or a selected Steed consumption prefix; not an automatic rotation or source-verified frame simulator.
observationContract.framesAndOrder: Every entry frame and same-frame order is observed input. Seconds are converted using the application timebase; do not infer a first tick phase, action impact frame, cooldown boundary inclusivity or internal callback order from talent text.
observationContract.firstTimeGainPhase: unknown; must be explicitly observed, never generated from an assumed cast+60 or cast+0 phase
observationContract.normalGainEvidence: actual qualifying Normal Attack contact; do not substitute a button press, charged hit or automatically counted candidate
observationContract.lunarGainEvidence: actual qualifying nearby-party Lunar-Crystallize trigger with Ascendant Gleam; Lunar-Crystallize damage tags alone do not prove a resource-gain trigger
observationContract.steedConsumption: requires at least cost before the observed valid release; deduct cost and count a use; the release resets only the Lunar-Crystallize resource-gain cooldown, not the Normal Attack gain cooldown
observationContract.steedResetOrder: the talent states that a valid Steed release resets the LC-gain cooldown, but does not establish consumption/reset/same-frame LC order; preserve the observed event order
observationContract.fourthUseExitOrder: four valid Steed releases end the mode, but the relation between exit, release, its two damage instances and other same-frame events is not source-proven
observationContract.burstExtension: an actual Q cast while the mode is active extends the current duration; no extension while already inactive and no source claim of only one extension per lifecycle
observationContract.completeLifecycleExit: require an observed exit record; do not synthesize a verified exact exit frame from the fourth release or duration arithmetic alone
observationContract.singleUsePrefix: truncate the ordered observation ledger immediately after the selected valid Steed consumption; retain only prior and same-frame-earlier entries needed to establish that consumption
observationContract.singleUseFuturePolicy: later gains, attacks, fourth-use exit and full lifecycle observation are not evidence requirements for an already observed selected consumption
observationContract.timebase: framesPerSecond=60 is the application ledger unit, not an independently established timing phase or animation model
